text.リフォームの費用は設備機器の有無や内装の仕様などによって大きく異なるため、広さだ: What a renovation costs varies a great deal with which fittings are included and how the interior is specified, so it cannot be settled by floor area alone. We know many people find that hard to get a grip on.
text.私共では、フローリングや漆喰の壁、キッチンやユニットバスなどの設備機器を含めたリ: We therefore set the cost out in two parts: the interior construction cost, covering the flooring, the lime plaster walls and fittings such as the kitchen and the unit bath; and the additional works cost, covering what each client particularly wanted — underfloor heating, wooden shutters, a stone wall at the entrance.
text.Timeless Livingで過去にリフォームされたお客様が、どのようにこだわ: Below are some of the homes we have renovated: what each client cared about, and what it cost.
text.記載されている費用は竣工当時の費用となります。: The figures given are the costs at the time each home was completed.
text.シンプルなデザインと、本物の質感にこだわった、家族のための明るい上質な住まい: A bright, finely made family home, built on simple design and the texture of real materials
text.生活時間に合わせた間取りと、防音サッシを設置し、お互いの時間に配慮した住まい: A plan arranged around two different daily rhythms, with acoustic sashes, so that each has their own hours
text.ウッドシャッター越しに広がる緑と光を取り込み、ゆったりと過ごせるリビングにこだわ: A home built around an unhurried living room, drawing in the greenery and the light beyond the wooden shutters
text.東西を繋ぐチークのアクセントウォールや、随所に設けた石の壁など、自然素材とデザイ: A home given over to natural materials and design: a teak accent wall running east to west, and stone walls set throughout
